# OpenAccountancy
This project is designed to simplify the accounting workflow in Mainland China.  
本项目旨在简化在中国（大陆）的会计工作流程。  

**!!! Before Use 使用前须知 !!!**  
***Accountants use this tool are responsible for all the content accepted and generated by this tool. Users must have accounting professional knowledge.  
使用此工具的会计工作人员需要对此工具接受和生成的所有内容负责。使用者必须具备会计专业知识。***
## 1. Main Functions 主要功能
Bookkeeping, Report Forms, and Taxation Affairs.  
记账，报表，及税务。
### 1.1 Bookkeeping 记账
#### 1.1.1 Regular Business 常规业务  
|Business|业务|
|:-------|---:|
|Voucher Management(Fill/Query/Edit/Remove)|凭证管理（填制/查询/编辑/删除）|
|Bookkeeping|记账|  
|Customized Carry-Over|自定义结转|  
|Cost of Sales Carry-Over|销售成本结转|  
|P&L Carry-Over During the Period|期间损益结转|
#### 1.1.2 Financial Statements 财务账表  
|Business|业务|
|:-------|---:|
|Account General Ledger|科目总账|  
|Subsidiary Ledger|科目明细账|  
|Account Journal|科目日记账|  
|General Ledger Trail Balance|科目余额表|  
|Account Daily Statement|科目日报表|  
|Account Summary|科目汇总表|  
|Cash Journal|现金日记账|
|Bank Deposit Journal|银行存款日记账|
#### 1.1.3 Statistical Statements 统计账表  
|Sheet|表格|
|:---|---:|
|Expense Accounts Balance Sheet|费用科目余额表|  
|Income Accounts Balance Sheet|收入科目余额表| 
|Receivable Accounts Balance Sheet|应收科目余额表| 
|Payable Accounts Balance Sheet|应付科目余额表| 
|Fund Accounts Balance Sheet|资金科目余额表| 
|Asset Structure Statement|资产结构表|
|Account Inventory Balance Sheet|科目存货余额表|  
#### 1.1.4 Document Management 档案管理  
|Function|功能|
|:-------|---:|
|Voucher Print|凭证打印|
|Account Book Print|账簿打印|
### 1.2 Report Forms 报表
- General Report Forms 报表生成
- Query Report Forms 报表查询  
- Statement of Assets and Liabilities 资产负债表
- Income Statement 利润表
- Cash Flow Statement 现金流量表
### 1.3 Taxation Affairs 税务
纳税申报表  
- 增值税申报表
- 企业所得税汇算清缴
- 企业所得税预缴申报表
- 文化事业建设费申报表
- 印花税申报表
- 附加税申报表

## 2. Implementation 实现
Stand-Alone Application: **TypeScript + Electron + React + better-sqlite3**   
We use **Electron** to build cross-platform application, with **React** to make interactive GUI. **TypeScript** ensures type-safety and maintainability. Meanwhile, library **better-sqlite** provides high performance **SQLite3** accessibility.
